title: Agent task, version 1
description: One unit of agent work in a campaign. A client claims the task for a lease, as a worker claims a job. The campaign, state, lease, attempts, and writer come from the database, not from this document. Omitted fields take their default values.

kind.description: A short work type that a claim can select, for example search, vetting, or review.

inputs.description: Records and files that the task uses.

priority.description: A claim takes the highest priority first, then the oldest task.

lease_seconds.description: Length of each lease. The holder extends the lease before it expires.

max_attempts.description: Claims permitted. After the last lease expires, the next claim records the task as failed.
